text.tspan: The 5 checkpoints a packet passes on a Linux host (netfilter hooks)
for me, or pass it on?
A request for -p 8080:80 goes PREROUTING → FORWARD → POSTROUTING.
ufw only filters INPUT, so it can't block a published port.
Fix: add your own rules to the DOCKER-USER chain,
The TO address must change before the routing decision.
If it changed later, the kernel would already have decided
"this is for me" and looked for a host process on 8080.
MASQUERADE sits in POSTROUTING: the last step before leaving.
